species.name: Squid
mustRead: torpedo mantle with triangular fins at the pointed rear
eight arms plus two longer clubbed tentacles
large eye at the base of the arms

species.name: Cuttlefish
mustRead: W-shaped horizontal pupil
undulating fin skirt running the full length of the mantle
eight short arms plus two longer retractable tentacles

species.name: Giant Octopus
mustRead: bulbous bag-like mantle sitting above the eyes
eight suckered arms of unequal length
horizontal slit pupil in a bulging eye
species.note: the big 'head' bulb is the mantle - the eyes sit below it, where the arms attach; no tentacles, only eight arms

species.name: Giant Squid
mustRead: two feeding tentacles far longer than the eight arms, with clubbed toothed tips
torpedo mantle with a small triangular fin pair at the tail end
dinner-plate eyes

species.name: Vampire Squid
mustRead: webbed cloak joining all eight arms into a cape
huge red-glowing eyes
pair of ear-like flap fins on the mantle

species.name: Deep-Sea Octopus
mustRead: ear-like fins flapping from the top of the mantle
webbed umbrella of skin between the eight arms
soft translucent gelatinous body
species.note: generic name - drawn as a finned dumbo-type deep-water octopus

species.name: Nautilus
mustRead: coiled chambered shell striped with red-brown flames
dozens of short tentacles fanning from the opening
leathery hood over the head
species.note: Around ninety small suckerless tentacles, not eight arms; the eye is a pinhole with no lens.
